pr_body:
The reaper can remove derived contexts of a point in time between query and fetch phases as their keep_alive is unset (-1).

Closes #67307
pr_title: Fix keep_alive of derived context of point in time

review_comment:
Should it be:

```suggestion
                readerContext = new ReaderContext(id, indexService, shard, reader, keepAliveInMillis, request.readerId() == null);
```
?

I think all search contexts that we created here should be a single-session; otherwise, we will leak them when the query phase returns no result. We should only create multiple-session contexts when we explicitly [open a point in time](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/29192e591cb62f1b6ace13073fda23b448f69be3/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/search/SearchService.java#L725). This is not an issue in the previous versions as we never create a search context when the readerId is specified.
